notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
[h1]Dear friends, it's time for our game update![/h1]

[h2]Have been added:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]Hardcore Mode[/h3]
New challenging game mode, with unique achievements

[*] [h3]New Quest in Act 5[/h3]
A new quest is available in the VIP lounge of Act 5

[*] [h3]Vending Machine[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/4d1ddbb6fe686363d117678c1f2cb4aeb4e8ee35.png[/img]Now in the vending machines you can buy consumables that make life easier for the protagonist

[*] [h3]New Achievements[/h3]
There are 7 new achievements in the game (not counting “Hardcore” mode achievements)

[*] [h3]Сheat Codes Book[/h3]
Bailey's store has a new item - a book of cheat codes, buying it resets your character's talents and stats

[*] [h3]Underground Tournament Act 2[/h3]
The NPC with the Underground Tournament Act 2 is back
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Dear friends, we have fixed some bugs:

[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[h2]Dear friends, we have fixed the most problematic bugs and added a new game mode:[/h2]

[h3]Story mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/89a0afa7a49413a937178c081d5b900c67b5a5f3.png[/img]
The game has a new mode - “ Story Mode” in this mode you will not lose progress when losing in the tournament

[h3]Ai correction in Critical-Strike[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/d0c3d5117722c0cd6f418c2437686bae1096446b.png[/img]
We fixed Ai in Critical-Strike, now CT bot will not skip moves during active bomb.

[h3]Hidden quest underground tournament act2/act55[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/9dec9d6ec635ea70dddb84e79817ed80b94d26f2.png[/img]
Due to bugs related to the underground tournament, we have hidden this quest. In the future, we will replace it with a new quest.

[h3]Surrender Button for Battle and Craft 2[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/25faf121d24670028b281a128695323074482ca5.png[/img]
It is now possible for a player to end a match early during a tournament

[list]
[*] Now in the second act, the player does not lose progress on defeats

[*] Now in the second and first act between matches, the stress is relieved

[*] Alerts with negative stress statuses are now closed automatically

[*] Critical-Strike bug with Bailey's training has been fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes 1.0
notes.content:
Dear friends, we have fixed some bugs:

[list]
[*] Fixed the bomb defuse bug in manual CS mode
[*] Fixed the soft lock when taking a call from C.T in CS (final of act4)
[*] Fixed the Act 1 Game over, now you can lose in Act 1 and get the “Game over” achievement
[*] Changed the talents of the opponents
[/list]

We're already working on other bugs, AI improvements, and new content

notes.title: Devlog 5 + Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Dear friends, it's time for a new Devlog, but before we start it we'd like to make a few announcements.

The first news is the exact release date - the full Esports History version will be released on Steam on [b]October 3, 2024[/b].

The second news is the announcement of Esports History: Prologue, a few weeks before the release we are going to release a free version of the beginning of the game which will contain all new mechanics from the full game. 
We hope you try the new version of the first acts and like it.

Our team has been working at a record pace for the last few months, even though it's not easy we realize that the release is inevitably coming, and that inspires us.

In the last 40 days we've done:

[h3]New dynamic background for locations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now under the locations will be a dynamic background that changes depending on the time of day.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/db079d3046338f45e68f85ded63bfe9886ba2b8c.gif[/img]

[h3]UI Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dialog window redesign
[*] Adding emotions for character sprites
[*] Updating interfaces
[*] Adding animations for interfaces
[*] Fonts update
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/578fb7249bbf07d0f180e1251135e09e6df85b06.gif[/img]

[h3]Menu for new mini-games[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/da0d4ea0d7625e6d349228c5e7b4881cbf0c61f5.gif[/img]

[h3]New Stress System[/h3]
[list]
[*] Several negative stress-related statuses have been added to the mini-games.
[*] Players can receive both minor debuffs and severe ones, the higher the stress the greater the risk of receiving a serious debuff.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/92093610aed5340bc0efbe12a2e6a7bf2e07a650.gif[/img]

[h3]Portable game consoles[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/63fc1db4d31748c925e4c619059885b911ce0bad.gif[/img]

[h3]Added automatic and semi-automatic modes for new mini-games[/h3]
[list]
[*] The new minigames have the option to play in new auto modes similar to what you saw in the demo, but additionally, the player has the option to play in hardcore manual mode.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/18beff8e88f7f6586d31592c9bbc82f4b7c9340e.gif[/img]

[h3]New game save system[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game will now save the game on its own.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/583c24e5f276bf734473eb3502bbc585bf5a246a.png[/img]

[h3]New experience system designed for 30 levels[/h3]
[h3]Animated intro between Act 2 and Act 3 [/h3]

We are also working on game balance, localization, and bug fixes. 
The release date is chosen so that we have enough time to fix as many bugs as possible and release a quality version of Esports History. 

[b]Thank you very much for waiting for our game![/b]

notes.title: Devlog 3
notes.content:
Dear friends, it's time to release a new devlog about the development of our game!

A lot of work has been done for the past time, and the work on the game did not stop. We have finished creating all game acts and added all bosses and side quests.

[list]
[*] At this stage, we can say that the playtime of the game will be more than 8 hours.
[*] There will also be more than 10 side quests in the game
[*] There will be 6 acts in the game, and each act will expand the gameplay
[*] The ability to build your PC from different components and play from home over the internet has already been realized.
[*] Character progression will consist of 30 levels and 43 talents (21 talents for the RTS genre and 23 for FPS).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/df7352031510889aef45e68414dbd37cb685513e.gif[/img]
To get the game ready for release, we still need to finalize the mechanics: mini-game guides, talent tree, new save system, in-depth stress system and polish the game balance.

For now, we are sticking to our previously planned schedule and plan to release the game at the end of August this year. 
We will do our best to meet this deadline.

Thank you so much for waiting for the game, we appreciate it and are putting our heart and soul into it!

notes.title: First devlog!
notes.content:
Dear friends, we are pleased to give you our first devlog, all this time we have been continuously working on Esports History, and we are planning our release at the end of this year ! Today we will tell you what we're working on and what you can expect in the full version of the game.

[h2][b]In-depth mini-games[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/01d8d382acc1a7d55e0e2b09cd6224605f5397d9.gif[/img]
Now we are almost finished working on a turn-based version of the famous FPS, now the outcome of tournament battles will affect not only the level of development of your character, but also the player's decisions. We also left the auto mode, so you can play our game more relaxed.
Also the RTS will be designed in a similar way, there will be much deeper mechanics , which will greatly improve  tournament gameplay.


[h2][b]Big City[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/7d4a62a21527dc4e041211810a0e5f5d3f7b2f49.png[/img]
In the full game you will have a new big city to unlock gradually, as well as a lot of new unique characters and bosses. 

[h2][b]New characters and bosses[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/ab50f1fa20ad43a27776138614a59c0a4a46a90e.gif[/img]
lot of new unique characters and bosses. 
Now to get to the tournaments will have to prove that you're worthy.

[h2][b]Your own PC[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/616904030b2f568a02dbdc2501c28433c3b7d3a6.png[/img]
Now your character will have to buy and build your own pc piece by piece.

We hope that you are also waiting for our game and will do our best to deliver you a release as soon as possible !
